summary: Extract attestation_io and harden symlink-parent traversal, JSON bounds, RFC3339 subseconds, and secrets

delivery.outcome: Extract bounded regular-file/JSON I/O and symlink/pointer helpers into src/attestation_io.py (< 500L), prevent symlink-parent traversal and 5000-digit/non-finite/surrogate JSON crashes, normalize 7-9 digit RFC3339 fractional seconds, convert _scan_secrets to iterative multi-pattern scanning, reject control characters in modelAdvice.model and absolute base paths in apply_invalid_case, expand tests/test_attestation.py, and mark merged ticket-009 DONE.
nonGoals: Do not change schemas/validation-attestation.schema.json or profiles/subactor-semcod.profile.json wire contracts

architecture.decision: Extract bounded regular-file/symlink/JSON loading and JSON Pointer helpers into src/attestation_io.py re-exported by src/attestation_primitives.py and src/attestation_check.py so all modules stay strictly below 500 lines.
architecture.rollback: Revert the ticket-010 branch commit or close the pull request before merge.
